name: Fairmont Miramar Hotel & Bungalows
insider_take: This Santa Monica icon sits where Hollywood legends once played, with a century-old Moreton Bay Fig tree as your majestic lobby centerpiece.
whats_special: The hotel's sprawling 32 bungalows were once home to stars like Greta Garbo and Clark Gable. The property's towering 80-foot fig tree, planted in 1889, is designated as Santa Monica's official city tree and creates a magical canopy over the front entrance.
pro_tip: Book a Palisades Park-facing room on floors 8-10 for unobstructed Pacific Ocean views and stunning sunsets over the Santa Monica Pier – locals say these are the best sunset views in all of LA.
dont_miss: The FIG Restaurant's weekend brunch under the historic tree, and a evening stroll through Palisades Park (directly across the street) where you'll find yourself on the same cliffs featured in countless Hollywood films.
pros: Historic charm with iconic 130-year-old Moreton Bay Fig Tree
Prime Santa Monica location steps from beach and pier
Luxurious bungalow accommodations with private patios
Upscale dining at The Bungalow restaurant and rooftop lounge
cons: Premium pricing reflects luxury beachfront location
Busy Santa Monica area with tourist crowds
